Room for what matters

The algebra records pages as it publishes them, then checks their finished markup for redundant return navigation and space reservations.

308 pages inspected · 0 targeted source findings. Desktop and mobile measurements are reported separately.

All assurance topics · Download the evidence · Rendered browser findings

What this can establish

A named Aaron Alderman home link plus a floating return control is redundant. Loading the return stylesheet without its control is an orphan dependency. Explicit body bottom spacing is a review candidate whose purpose remains undecided.

What remains open

The source audit does not measure visible whitespace. Browser evidence must include the route, viewport, runtime state, document height and footer position. Repeated header/footer links and generous spacing are not automatically defects.
